specialAccess.title: Special permissions
specialAccess.subtitle: Admin gives the accountant, or anyone else, an extra right for a set time, inside limits Admin fixes · it switches itself off when the time ends
specialAccess.pickNone: No rights can be given as a special permission on this database yet.
specialAccess.askLead: Admin sees your request and decides. If approved, it switches on and off by itself at the times you ask for.

f.longest: Longest allowed: {{count}} days. It turns off by itself at the end time, and Admin can stop it at any moment.
f.longestUnset: The longest allowed time is set in Settings. It turns off by itself at the end time, and Admin can stop it at any moment.
f.upTo: Up to a number of times
f.reasonPh: e.g. month-end close: post the missing cash book lines
f.otpNote: Admin code on WhatsApp arrives in Phase 3.
f.whatsappNote: Admin gets a WhatsApp message when it starts, at each use if chosen, and when it ends (Phase 3).

err.starts: Enter the start date and time.
err.ends: Enter an end after the start.
err.maxUses: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
err.reason: Say why, in at least 5 characters.

specialAccess.asked: Request sent to Admin. It shows under Requests.

list.title: Given, running and ended
list.sub: Each use is listed under its permission in the user log
list.caption: Special permissions given
list.empty: None given yet. Each permission you give shows here as Scheduled, Running, Stopped or Ended.
list.emptyOwn: No permissions have been given to you yet.
list.loadFailed: Could not load the permissions. Reload the page; if it happens again, ask Admin.

stop.title: Stop this permission
stop.effect: Stops {{code}} ({{label}} for {{name}}) now. It can't be used again; a new permission is needed. Recorded in the user log.

req.title: Requests
req.sub: People ask; Admin decides. Nobody decides their own request.
req.caption: Pending requests for special permissions
req.approveEffect: Gives {{name}} the permission “{{label}}” from {{from}} to {{to}}, with any number of uses. Recorded in the user log.
req.refuseEffect: Refuses {{name}}'s request for “{{label}}”. Nothing is given. Recorded in the user log.

limits.title: Limits Admin fixes for everyone
limits.cashPay: Cash to one person in a day
limits.note: A permission can never go past these limits. Changing them needs Admin's OTP and goes in the user log.

office.title: Office admin · GST transactions only
office.lead: A second admin login for a manager. It runs the office: staff logins, products, price lists, tasks and settings. It sees transactions with GST only.
office.canV: Add staff logins, products, prices, tasks, forms
office.cannotV: See or enter without GST, give rights, restore
office.everyV: In the user log, seen by Admin
office.foot: It is labelled Office admin everywhere it appears, and it can't be used in place of the full books. When the CA, the auditor or a tax officer asks for the accounts, they get the full books from Admin.

specialAccess.readOnly: Read-only access: you can see permissions but not give or ask for them.
